title: The Straight Line

script.text: You can sail [32,000|thirty-two thousand] kilometers in a straight line, and never touch land.

script: It starts here, on a beach in Pakistan.

script.text: Point a ship south-west, and never turn the wheel.

script: You slip between Africa and Madagascar.
You pass under the tip of Africa, cross the South Atlantic, and thread the gap between Antarctica and South America.
Then the whole Pacific. North, for weeks.

script.text: The first land you hit is Russia.
Total distance: [32,090|thirty-two thousand and ninety] kilometers.

script: That's about [80%|eighty percent] of the way around Earth.
In [2012|twenty twelve], someone on Reddit posted this route.

script.text: In [2018|twenty eighteen], two researchers built an algorithm to check it. It held.

script: The longest straight line on land? Portugal to China. About [11,000|eleven thousand] kilometers.
We call it planet Earth. From out here, it looks more like planet Ocean.
